title: Introduction to AI for Cyber Security
officialTitle: UNIT I: Introduction to AI for Cyber Security
summary: Explores the fundamental paradigm shift from signature-based defense to data-driven AI systems. Covers cybersecurity data sources, challenges of high-dimensional log data, and the data pipeline.
memoryCodeMeaning: Entity logs, Label scarcity, Time-series, JSON parsing, Curse of dimensionality

title: AI for Cyber Security Arsenal
officialTitle: UNIT II: AI for Cyber Security Arsenal
summary: Core algorithms for security analytics: supervised classification for intrusion detection, regression for blast-radius modeling, unsupervised clustering for attacker profiling, and anomaly detection.
memoryCodeMeaning: Classification, Regression, Dimensionality reduction, Clustering, Vectorization, NLP for logs, Isolation forests

title: Detecting Cyber Security Threats with AI
officialTitle: UNIT III: Detecting Cyber Security Threats with AI
summary: Real-world threat detection engines using NLP, feature extraction, and deep learning for phishing email detection, malicious URL/domain identification, and malware classification.
memoryCodeMeaning: Phishing detection, Spam filtering, Lexical domain analysis, DGA classification, N-gram feature hashing, Neural malware signatures

title: Protecting Sensitive Information and Assets
officialTitle: UNIT IV: Protecting Sensitive Information and Assets
summary: Identity defense, behavioral biometrics, account reputation scoring, keystroke dynamics, and facial recognition for zero-trust authentication and access protection.
memoryCodeMeaning: Account reputation, Risk-based authentication, Keystroke dynamics, Facial recognition biometric verification

title: Fraud Prevention with AI Solutions
officialTitle: UNIT V: Fraud Prevention with AI Solutions
summary: Real-time payment fraud prevention, synthetic identity detection, ensemble learning (Bagging, Random Forests, Gradient Boosted Trees), and model evaluation with extreme class imbalance.
memoryCodeMeaning: Metric selection (PR-AUC), Bagging & ensembles, Joint fraud graphs, Synthetic identity detection
